_comment: Official, machine-readable documentation for each tool the launchpad guides. Checked 2026-11-05. launchpad-docs.mjs reads this file. 'index' is searched for the query; 'mcp' is the vendor's own docs server, preferred when the client has it connected. Add a source here, never a blog or a mirror.

nextjs.name: Next.js
nextjs.pages: Every docs page returns Markdown when fetched with Accept: text/markdown, or with .md appended.
nextjs.versioned: The index header states @doc-version. Compare it with the project's installed version.

mcp.name: next-devtools
mcp.note: Official (vercel/next-devtools-mcp). Docs search plus live errors, routes and logs from a running next dev (16+).

astro.name: Astro
astro.pages: No llms.txt. Pages are HTML; the script strips them to text. Prefer the MCP server.

mcp.name: astro-docs
mcp.note: Official Astro Docs MCP. No auth.

nuxt.name: Nuxt
nuxt.pages: Append .md to a page URL or send Accept: text/markdown.

sveltekit.name: SvelteKit and Svelte
sveltekit.pages: The llms.txt files are the full docs as one text; the script searches their sections.

mcp.name: svelte
mcp.note: Official Svelte MCP (docs sections plus a Svelte 5 code autofixer). No auth.

sanity.name: Sanity
sanity.pages: Append .md to a page URL or send Accept: text/markdown.

mcp.name: sanity
mcp.note: Official. OAuth sign-in. Docs search, schema, GROQ and content tools. `sanity init` sets it up together with Sanity's agent skills.

mcp.name: vercel
mcp.note: Official. OAuth sign-in. Docs search plus projects, deployments and logs.

tailwind.name: Tailwind CSS
tailwind.pages: No machine index. Fetch a docs page URL directly (HTML, stripped to text).

google-search.name: Google Search Central
google-search.pages: Authoritative for SEO rules (sitemaps, robots, canonical, structured data). Fetch pages directly.

mdn.name: MDN Web Docs (HTML, CSS, accessibility, headers)
